draft_metadata.title: The crossing number of the complete graph minus an edge
draft_metadata.description: for every integer n >= 2 and every edge e of K_n, cr(K_n - e) = Z(n) - C(floor((n-1)/2), 2); ordinary drawings, no restriction on vertex positions or edge routes. for all m >= 4 and n >= 1, P_n the path with n edges, cr(K_m box P_n) = (1/4) floor((m+1)/2) floor((m-1)/2) floor((m-2)/2) (n floor((m+4)/2) + floor((m-4)/2)), via Ouyang-Wang-Huang 2014 Corollary 5.1 (cited, not re-audited). The new lower bound is odd complete orders n>=15; the new product input is odd m>=13 and path length n>=2. Pinned upstream statements are stipulated premises. Lean support is partial; the full crossing theorem is not formalized.
